name: pluribus-ai
description: Connect your editor to Pluribus: REST orchestration, health, recall/record hooks — server owns memory semantics.

pluribus.baseUrl.description: Pluribus API base URL (no trailing slash).

pluribus.apiKey.description: Optional X-API-Key when PLURIBUS_API_KEY is set on the server.

pluribus.defaultTags.description: Comma-separated tags for recall/record requests (situation tags, not workspace silos).

pluribus.orchestrator.enabled.description: Enable automatic recall/record on hooked events.

pluribus.orchestrator.recallOnTaskStart.description: POST /v1/recall/compile when a VS Code task starts.

pluribus.orchestrator.recallOnDebugStart.description: POST /v1/recall/compile when a debug session starts.

pluribus.orchestrator.recallOnSave.description: If true, debounced recall after file save (can be noisy).

pluribus.orchestrator.maxRecallTotal.description: max_total for compile requests from the orchestrator.

pluribus.orchestrator.recordOnTaskProces.description: POST /v1/advisory-episodes when a task process exits non-zero (requires onDidEndTaskProcess).

pluribus.orchestrator.recordOnDebugEnd.description: If true, record when any debug session ends (noisy; off by default).

pluribus.nudges.whenDisconnected.description: Show one soft warning per session when auto-recall fails with network error (HTTP status 0).

pluribus.nudges.afterConsecutiveTaskFail.description: If >0, information message when this many consecutive task process failures occur (0=off).

pluribus.metrics.logIntervalMinutes.description: Append metrics line to Output on this interval; 0=off.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run icons && npm run compile
